coverage.category: 1. Household employers: domestic workers, live-in carers, nannies
coverage.found: No employer-side register or periodic report found for private households. Only context: patent for home care of the elderly allowed from 11 March 2025 (Law 93/1998 position 2.54); CNAM paper notice within 10 working days for employees without a personal ID number. Nothing actionable.

coverage.category: 2. Scrap-metal dealers
coverage.found: Environmental permits for waste management oblige holders to keep records of waste type and weight collected and handed over, and to hand over only to permitted ferrous/non-ferrous operators (Agency of Environment sample permit AM24040901). No public register or periodic report found. Weak candidate.

coverage.category: 3. Second-hand dealers and pawnbrokers
coverage.found: Pawnshops are listed in the CSSM special register with precious-metal traders and fall under AML control. No pawnshop-specific reporting rule found. See precious-metals candidate.

coverage.category: 4. Gold and jewellery buyers
coverage.found: Camera de Stat pentru Supravegherea Marcării (CSSM) keeps a register of about 421 entities under Law 282/2004, controls marking and AML compliance, and requires provenance documents (customs declaration, invoice) when articles are submitted for hallmarking. Periodic reporting terms not confirmed.

coverage.category: 5. Used car parts and vehicle dismantlers
coverage.found: End-of-life vehicle regulation HG 93/2023 (transposes Directive 2000/53/EC) is in force; the Agency of Environment monitors it and the Environmental Inspectorate controls it. Dismantler authorisation procedure and reporting forms not found.

coverage.category: 6. Livestock traders, markets and animal transport
coverage.found: State Animal Register (SIA RSA, run by ANSA) under Law 231/2006 issues movement certificates and event declarations. A 2026 draft amendment adds traceability duties. It is a state system with free forms, so little room for a private product. Rules for markets and animal transport not found.

coverage.category: 7. Small abattoirs and butchers
coverage.found: Nothing new. Law 196/2024 on animal health and Law 82/2024 on official controls are cited as extending traceability and authorisation duties, with entry into force expected in 2026. Small-abattoir rules and register not found.

coverage.category: 8. Beekeepers
coverage.found: Apiary data registration is mandatory since Law 154/2022, with fines of 24-35 UC for individuals and 40-70 UC for legal entities, and apiary passports are required. The state BeeProtect app (HG 369/2023) is free and notifies beekeepers of spraying within 7 km. About 9,000 beekeepers; under a third hold a valid passport. Killed by the free state tool.

coverage.category: 9. Veterinary practices and veterinary medicine sellers
coverage.found: ANSA inspection checklist for veterinary units (Law 221/2007 art. 18, Law 119/2018 art. 24). Staffing rules are being tightened (Veterinary College proposal, Laws 82/2024 and 196/2024). No periodic reporting duty found for private vets.

coverage.category: 10. Well drillers and water abstraction
coverage.found: HG 731/2025 sets mandatory procedures for conserving, rehabilitating and closing defective or abandoned water abstraction wells, with owner duties of operation, monitoring and reporting. Special water users keep a water register and file the annual statistical report 'nr. 1-gospodărirea apelor' with Apele Moldovei (HG 835/2013 regime). Household thresholds not found.

coverage.category: 11. Septic, sanitation and waste haulers
coverage.found: Not specifically searched. Waste hauler permits sit under the Agency of Environment regime, already covered by K02 and the scrap-metal finding.

coverage.category: 12. Lift, boiler and pressure-equipment owners and inspectors
coverage.found: HG 506/2017 sets minimum safety requirements for operating lifts. Law 151/2022 on industrial safety of hazardous objects covers pressure vessels, boilers and lifting equipment, with attested staff training and an information notice valid 12 months. Owners (condominium associations, small firms) must keep these inspections current. Inspection calendar tools not checked.

coverage.category: 13. Small water systems
coverage.found: ANRE licenses all public water and sewerage operators, including small settlement-level ones, for 25 years. Instruction 564/2020 sets periodic reporting for all licence holders, and ANRE sets tariffs on cost-justification sheets. Number of small operators and existing tools not checked.

coverage.category: 14. Pesticide and fertiliser dealers and applicators
coverage.found: Farmers and plant-protection service providers must keep a treatment register, certified and sealed at ANSA territorial units. HG 451/2025 sets the content and format of professional users' records; FAOLEX gives entry into force as 1 January 2027 (not confirmed on the primary text). Law 21/2025 makes the dealer register under HG 1045/2005, with quarterly stock reporting, obsolete.

coverage.category: 15. Labour contractors and recruitment agencies
coverage.found: Agencies need a licence from the Licensing Chamber (Law 102/2003, Law 180/2008) and ANOFM's list requires an activity report on emigrant placements. A June 2026 draft from the Ministry of Labour would remove the Moldovan-citizens-only recruitment limit; adoption not confirmed. Thin and dated.

coverage.category: 16. Cemeteries, burial societies and funeral services
coverage.found: No national funeral or cemetery law in force. HG 1072/1998 plus municipal rules apply, with cemetery administrators keeping grave records. A cemeteries and crematoria bill (initiative 101/2023) is pending. Buyers are municipalities, which are hard for a solo founder.

coverage.category: 17. Community and religious bodies: associations, charities, halal and kosher supervision
coverage.found: Associations had to file beneficial-owner data with ASP by 31 December 2025, with fines of 1,000-1,500 UC. That deadline has passed, so only a recurring update duty remains. Halal/kosher not searched.

coverage.category: 18. Transport operators: minibus, taxi, moto-taxi, small trucking and bus fleets
coverage.found: Law 284/2023 requires taxi operators to connect to the SFS SIA MEV and bars foreign-only booking platforms. The TAXI18 payroll tax regime is repealed from 1 July 2026. ANTA planned 498 controls for 2026. Bolt entered Chisinau in September 2025, working only with licensed taxi firms. Regular-route programme changes are contested by APOTA.

coverage.category: 19. Market traders, street vendors, money changers
coverage.found: Money changers: BNM Instruction under HCE 254/2025, in force 1 January 2026, replaces the 2016 rules. Daily rate reports are due by 10:00 (and 16:00 if rates change), monthly operations reports by the 5th, via the BNM web portal with a qualified electronic signature, and records are kept at least 5 years. SPCSB also has a special AML form for exchange units. Market traders and street vendors not searched.

coverage.category: 20. Small licensed premises with inspections: tattoo studios, driving schools, childminders and nurseries, small food producers, hunting outfitters
coverage.found: Small food producers: HG 6/2025 simplified requirements and ANSA registration list (Law 221/2024). Alternative childcare services under Law 367/2022 and HG 572/2023. Driving schools: accreditation mechanism being revised and instructor exam-attendance pilot until 1 September 2026. Tattoo studios and hunting outfitters not reached.

candidates.trigger: B2B e-Factura reportedly mandatory from 1 Oct 2026 (private blog; not confirmed officially)

coverage.category: 21. Fuel stations and fuel or LPG distributors
coverage.found: ANRE licensing: 84 retail licensees running 577 stations at 31.03.2026 (607 stations in register at 31.12.2025, 447 mixed). Law 461/2001 on petroleum products market. ANRE amended a petroleum stocks decision in 2026 (title only seen, content unread). No small-operator reporting pain found; market is small and operators are mid-sized. Nothing new beyond a weak, unverified stocks-compliance idea.

coverage.category: 22. Grain, coffee, cocoa and other commodity traders, millers and warehouses
coverage.found: Only the wheat/maize/sunflower import licensing regime (set Oct 2023, extended to 30 June 2025; status after that not confirmed). No grain warehouse register or ANSA stock-reporting duty found. Coffee/cocoa not applicable.

coverage.category: 23. Co-operatives, credit unions and savings groups
coverage.found: Savings and loan associations (AEI) are supervised by the National Bank of Moldova under Law 139/2007 (BNM sanctions page, decision of 11.06.2026); the CNPF material seen appears older. Reporting forms and deadlines not found; number of AEI unknown.

coverage.category: 24. Private clinics, labs and other health providers that bill insurers or state schemes
coverage.found: CNAM model contract (GD 770/2022; 2026 contracts signed 31.12.2025): provider must send monthly activity reports by the 5th, harm-to-insured cases by the 10th, and hospital data through the DRG case-mix system. Private-provider union objected to a 2026 draft favouring public providers. No gap or product evidence.

coverage.category: 25. Pharmacies, medicine importers, and users of controlled chemicals or precursors
coverage.found: AMDM authorisations for narcotics, psychotropics and precursors under Law 382/1999 and GD 1088/2004, multi-year validity (latest seen valid to 2029). No periodic reporting pain found. Pharmacy eRetete/CNAM already K05 (rejected).

coverage.category: 26. Security, cleaning and manpower agencies, and the firms that hire their workers
coverage.found: Security agencies are licensed under Law 283/2003 and GD 667/2005; the issuing body appears to be MAI's national public security inspectorate (single procurement document, unverified). Guard training and medical checks are required. Nothing found on 2025-2026 rule changes; cleaning and manpower agencies not found.

coverage.category: 27. Construction, mining and quarry contractors and suppliers: site registers, accreditation, local-content reports
coverage.found: Site supervisors (dirigintii de santier) are attested by the Ministry of Infrastructure and Regional Development (certificates valid 5 years). A government announcement (gov.md node 10089, undated, linked to MIDR draft NU-297-2026) says amendments will require electronic registration of project-verification opinions and expert reports, and quarterly activity reports from site supervisors. The PDF text could not be read. Mining and quarry duties not reached.

coverage.category: 28. Notaries, land agents, real estate brokers and other professionals with periodic or anti-money-laundering reports
coverage.found: New real estate agents law: voted 26.03.2026, published 23.04.2026, in force 23.01.2027 (logos-pres). Agents need a competence certificate issued by ANGC and a listing in a new 'Agenti imobiliari' module of the Real Estate Price Register; the first-reading draft also required reporting each brokerage contract within 15 working days. AML (Law 308/2017) reporting for agents and notaries not confirmed; SPCSB has run real estate AML training.

coverage.category: 29. Hotels, guest houses and short-term rentals: guest registers, tourism levies
coverage.found: Nothing current. Only a 2012 reference to an Integrated Tourist Registration System (unconfirmed), and the tourism promotion tax that applies to travel agencies and operators, not accommodation. H1 2026 accommodation arrivals were up 15.8% (257.3 thousand). No local guest-register or levy rule confirmed.

coverage.category: 30. Small exporters and importers facing traceability or certification rules: food, fish, timber, forest-risk commodities
coverage.found: ANSA phytosanitary certificate fees for export and re-export were abolished from 5 Feb 2026 (Law 227/2025); animal-product exports need an official sanitary-veterinary certificate (Order 57/2023). Walnut share in EU market fell to 2.2% in H1 2026. No EUDR-relevant Moldovan commodity trade found. Nothing new.

coverage.category: 31. Wine and viticulture producers (SINVV declarations, vineyard register)
coverage.found: Law 57/2006 art. 266: harvest declaration by 1 December, production declaration by 15 January, plantation changes declared in time, input-output register; vineyard plots over 0.15 ha and wine units are registered in the vine and wine information system. A state RPV Online app lets users view their data. Small winemakers up to 1,000 hl dispute a 250,000 lei guarantee (ONIV, Feb 2026).

coverage.category: 32. Personal data protection under Law 195/2024
coverage.found: Law 195/2024 (GDPR-style) in force since 23 Aug 2026, with a 2-year transition; it requires records of processing, risk analyses and a designated responsible person (arts. 37 and 39). Whether controller registration or notification with CNPDCP survives, and whether SMEs are exempt, is not confirmed.

coverage.category: 33. Agricultural subsidies and the Farmers' Register (AIPA/MAIA)
coverage.found: AIPA subsidy dossiers (historic window 1 Feb to 31 Oct; may be outdated), diesel excise compensation (applications from 11 May 2026), drought-loss aid from 25 May, and an active-farmer income declaration form (AIPA Order 98 of 03.07.2026). The Farmers' Register has about 20,000 farmers; MAIA data-collection and training contracts run 1 Sep to 15 Dec 2026.

coverage.category: 34. Transport and freight documents (goods consignment note, e-Transport)
coverage.found: No Moldovan e-Transport system exists in the results (that is Romania). The consignment note (aviz de insotire) is a special-regime primary document with a simplified issuing procedure; no mandatory electronic version found. Nothing new.

coverage.category: 35. Tourism promotion tax and travel agencies
coverage.found: The promotion tax (10-30 lei by destination) falls on travel agencies and tour operators, collected via the tax service; the notice was undated so current status is unconfirmed. No product angle seen.

coverage.category: 36. e-Factura B2B timing (country-specific check)
coverage.found: A private blog (invoicedataextraction.com) says B2B e-Factura becomes mandatory from 1 Oct 2026; not confirmed on an official site. Today is 2026-10-09, so the mandate may just have started. Already covered by K01, K03 and K06.

Licensed fuel importers and wholesalers' stock and licence duties; unverified, so keep.
Grain import licence regime; later status not found, so verifiers decide.
Small security firms' licence and guard-file duties; in scope.
